description: This file defines the LocationMenuConfigurator class which implements menu configuration for location-related screens in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It utilizes traits and interfaces to override default screen behavior for location viewing.

classes.name: LocationMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for location management screens within the OrangeHRM admin plugin, overriding the default screen to 'viewLocations'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the Screen using the module screen helper trait to set the view to 'viewLocations', implementing the MenuConfigurator interface requirement.
